name: Office of the University Registrar
handles: Academic records, transcripts, enrollment verification, and missing semester records.
boundaries: Financial holds go to Student Financials. Prerequisite overrides, advising, class standing, and dean's list approval may require the school/college.

name: BU Financial Assistance — undergraduate
handles: Undergraduate aid applications, missing expected aid, supporting documents, and aid appeals.
boundaries: Posted account charges, refunds, and late fees go to Student Financials. Graduate aid generally goes to the school/program aid office.

name: Student Financials / Student Accounting Services
handles: Student account billing, payment arrangements, posted transactions, financial holds, and late-fee review.
boundaries: Missing expected aid and aid eligibility go to the relevant financial aid office. Login authentication failures go to IT.

name: BU Housing — assignments
handles: Ordinary housing assignment changes, room-change requests, and roommate requests.
boundaries: Disability-based housing requests require DAS. Physical repairs use residential maintenance channels. Housing portal authentication errors go to IT.

name: Residential maintenance — residence office / FMO
handles: Routine residence upkeep and repair issues, via the residence office; furniture/appliances via My Housing.
boundaries: This is a service queue, not a direct API into FMO. Follow official intake instructions. Urgent hazards must not wait in a routine ticket queue.

name: IS&T IT Help Center
handles: BU authentication, account access, connectivity, and technical help intake.
boundaries: IT can investigate login/system access failures; it cannot approve aid, remove financial holds, or grant academic overrides.

name: Disability & Access Services
handles: Disability accommodation eligibility and requests for academic access; disability-based housing review.
boundaries: Routine repairs are maintenance. Ordinary room changes are Housing. Existing accommodated testing scheduling may require the testing center.

name: International Students & Scholars Office
handles: International student immigration-status and travel-document advising.
boundaries: Route for advising only; the classifier does not determine immigration eligibility or provide legal advice. Financial transactions remain with Student Financials.

name: Terrier Card Office
handles: Terrier Card replacement and meal-plan/card-account questions; official meal-plan changes use My Housing.
boundaries: Login failures go to IT; tuition billing goes to Student Financials. Food-service feedback is not automatically a Terrier Card issue.

name: University Service Center — undergraduate leave guidance
handles: General undergraduate leave/discontinuation guidance and related process questions.
boundaries: Scope depends on school and student status; graduate and some program workflows differ. Immigration effects require ISSO; academic planning requires advising.
